ClockTime Implementation & DOLE Compliance Guide

Everything you need to set up multi-branch time tracking, tablet kiosks, and Philippine payroll automation.

1. Quick Start (5 Minutes)

Create your company workspace, define your branches (e.g. Makati HQ, BGC Store), and choose between mobile app clock-ins (with GPS geofencing) or shared tablet kiosks (with PIN and selfie verification).

2. Philippine Labor Standards (DOLE Rule II Book III)

  • Ordinary Overtime (125%): Work performed in excess of 8 regular hours per day.
  • Rest Day & Special Non-Working Holiday (130%): Work performed on a scheduled rest day or national special holiday.
  • Regular Holiday (200%): Work performed on DOLE declared regular national holidays.
  • Night Shift Differential (+10%): Work performed between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM.

3. Statutory Deductions Automation (2026 Schedule)

ClockTime automatically calculates the 14% SSS contribution schedule (9.5% employer / 4.5% employee split), 5% PhilHealth split, Pag-IBIG mandatory ₱200 cap, and semi-monthly revised BIR 2316 withholding tax tables.

4. Hardware & Biometrics Integration

Connect physical ZKTeco optical fingerprint terminals and facial recognition turnstiles via standard REST API webhooks. Attendance logs sync to the cloud in real time with offline buffer support.
